title: Agentic · Mechanical enforcement antes de dispatch
mission: Cerrá el miss MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT que el benchmark adversarial mantiene visible. Reutilizá scripts/compiled-dispatch-contract-lib.mjs, Specification Assurance y el gate pre-dispatch existentes para convertir requisitos semánticos que hoy pueden quedar como evidencia descriptiva en validaciones ejecutables fail-closed antes de publicar trabajo claim-ready. No construyas otro planner, scheduler o authority surface. Conservá compatibilidad histórica segura y no conviertas toda semántica en un cuestionario o bloqueo humano.
definition_of_done: MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT deja de ser miss del benchmark por una validación ejecutable pre-dispatch, no por cambiar o relajar la fixture.
Un compiled work que omite una transición, restricción o invariant requerida por su contrato falla cerrado antes de volverse claim-ready.
Un work compatible que satisface las mismas invariants sigue pasando; los harnesses históricos de compiled-dispatch permanecen PASS.
El benchmark adversarial reduce el residual sin aumentar las violaciones de sus negative controls contextuales.
La implementación reutiliza owners existentes y no crea scheduler, queue, CURRENT, planner o promotion authority nuevos.
allowed_scope: coordination/portfolio/tests/fixtures/agentic_adversarial_correction_benchmark_v1.json only if adding a strictly non-relaxing regression case is required
coordination/guide/** only where the existing compiled-dispatch contract requires a bounded compatible change
forbidden_scope: relaxing or renaming the MECHANICAL_ENFORCEMENT case to manufacture coverage
human continuation as a substitute for executable enforcement
runtime scope or promotion authority expansion

semantic_identity.problem: semantic safety requirements can remain descriptive evidence instead of fail-closed executable enforcement before dispatch
acceptance: adversarial benchmark moves the mechanical enforcement case out of the residual miss set without increasing contextual false positives
compliant historical workblocks remain compatible and existing compiled-dispatch regressions pass
invalid compiled work lacking enforceable required transitions or constraints fails closed before claim-ready publication
mechanical_enforcement is anticipated before dispatch by executable validation rather than prose

truth_boundary: This job closes one named adversarial enforcement miss through existing pre-dispatch owners. It grants no scheduling, claim, promotion or human-approval authority.
